scene: Your dog barks happily, drawing three departing transports to the roof edge.
picture: A flat side view along the rooftop edge. On the left, a wicker passenger gondola suspended beneath quadcopter blades hovers beside a gate. Near the centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit stands with her happy dog, next to an idling mint-green flying scooter. On the right, a red double-decker hover bus idles with doors open.
